
<!-- #Load Data  -->
```{r}
#| label: load-complex-care-data
#| include: false

# Set default fallback parameters for running code interactively during
# development since Quarto params are only passed when rendering the document
if (
  !exists(
    "params"
  )
) {
  params <- list(
    start_date = "2026-07-01",
    end_date = "2026-09-30",
    fiscal_system = "state"
  )
}

params$start_date <- lubridate::ymd(
  params$start_date
)
params$end_date <- lubridate::ymd(
  params$end_date
)

# Load ETL output
source(
  "R/load_data.R"
)

# Run the function to load complex care data
complex_care_data <- load_complex_care_data()

# Build subsets
complex_care_subsets <- build_complex_care_subsets(
  full_data = complex_care_data$complex_care_data$complex_care_full_data,
  start_date = params$start_date,
  end_date   = params$end_date,
  fiscal_system = params$fiscal_system
)

complex_care_initiated  <- complex_care_subsets$initiated_within_period
complex_care_dismissed  <- complex_care_subsets$dismissed_within_period
complex_care_selected_not_enrolled <- complex_care_subsets$active_selected_not_enrolled_within_period
complex_care_enrolled_not_admitted <- complex_care_subsets$active_enrolled_not_admitted_within_period
complex_care_admitted_no_tx_team   <- complex_care_subsets$active_admitted_no_tx_team_within_period

complex_care_full_data <- complex_care_data$complex_care_data$complex_care_full_data

mercy_utilization <- complex_care_data$complex_care_data$transform$referral_flow$ext_mercy_utilization

alerting_data <- complex_care_data$complex_care_data$transform$referral_flow$ext_atd_notifications

complex_care_outreach_notes <- complex_care_data$complex_care_data$raw$complex_care_outreach_notes

```
<!-- #Referrals and Selections -->
```{r}
#| label: funnel set up

#Count number of referrals and selections 
quarterly_counts <- complex_care_full_data %>%
  summarise(
    Referrals = sum(
      enrollment_starting_date >= params$start_date &
      enrollment_starting_date <= params$end_date,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Selections = sum(
      roster_added_cohort_date >= params$start_date &
      roster_added_cohort_date <= params$end_date,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "stage",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stage = factor(
      stage,
      levels = c(
        "Referrals",
        "Selections"
        # "Enrollments",
        # "Admissions"
      )
    ),
    stage_num = as.numeric(stage),
    xmin = -count / 2,
    xmax = count / 2,
    ymin = stage_num - 0.42,
    ymax = stage_num + 0.42
  )

#Create plot
quarterly_counts_plot <- ggplot(
  quarterly_counts
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = 0,
      xmax = count,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax
      ),
    fill = "#0072B2"
  ) +
  geom_text(
  aes(
    x = count,
    y = stage_num,
    label = count
    ),
  color = "black",
  fontface = "bold",
  size = 5,
  hjust = -0.3
) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = quarterly_counts$stage_num,
    labels = quarterly_counts$stage
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0, max(quarterly_counts$count)*1.2)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(r = -4)
      ),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank()
  )

quarterly_counts_plot
```

<!-- #Month Table Setup -->
```{r}
#| label: monthly-table-setup

#Create fiscal year month order
fy_months <- c(
  month.name[7:12],
  month.name[1:6]
)

#Set status levels to appear on table
status_levels <- c(
  "Referrals",
  "Selections",
  "Enrollments",
  "Admissions"
)

#Only show the months within parameters
report_months <- seq(
  from = floor_date(params$start_date, "month"),
  to = floor_date(params$end_date, "month"),
  by = "month"
) %>%
  format("%B")

# Create a monthly summary table of referrals, cohort additions,
# enrollments, and admissions occurring during the reporting period
achieved_monthly_table_prep <- complex_care_full_data %>% 
 select(
  client_number,
  client_last,
  client_first,
  gender_description,
  race_description,
  mrn_mercy,
  tiedenrollment,
  enrollment_starting_date,
  enrollment_ending_date,
  dismissal_reason_description,
  age_at_enrollment,
  roster_added_cohort_date,
  roster_complex_care_referral_source_description,
  roster_program_assigned,
  roster_payor_is_optum_uhc,
  benchmarks_first_post_referral_contact_date,
  benchmarks_enrollment_date,
  benchmarks_first_post_enrollment_contact_date,
  benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date,
  benchmarks_psych_eval_date,
  benchmarks_treatment_team_assignment_date,
  pfp_discharge_pfp_discharge_date
 ) %>% 
 mutate(
    across(
      c(
       enrollment_starting_date,
        roster_added_cohort_date,
        benchmarks_enrollment_date,
        benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date
      ),
    ymd
  )
 ) %>%
#Use pivot_longer to create one row per milestone date for each client, filtering
#out missing dates and keeping dates only within the reporting period
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      enrollment_starting_date,
      roster_added_cohort_date,
      benchmarks_enrollment_date,
      benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date
      ),
    names_to = "status_raw",
    values_to = "status_date"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(
      status_date
      ),
    between(
      status_date,
      params$start_date,
      params$end_date
      )
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    Month  = format(
     status_date,
     "%B"
    ),
    Status = recode(
      status_raw,
      enrollment_starting_date = "Referrals",
      roster_added_cohort_date = "Selections",
      benchmarks_enrollment_date = "Enrollments",
      benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date = "Admissions"
    )
  ) %>%
#Count how many milestones occurred within each month, use complete include every combination
# filling missing counts with zero.
  count(
    Status,
    Month,
    name = "Count"
    ) %>%
  complete(
    Status = status_levels,
    Month = report_months,
    fill = list(
     Count = 0
    )
   ) %>%
#Convert month to a factor so it presents in order. Pivot_wider so that each status
#has one row and each month has it's own column.
  mutate(
    Month = factor(
      Month,
      levels = fy_months
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Status,
    Month
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Month,
    values_from = Count
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(
      Status,
      levels = status_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = rowSums(
      across(
        all_of(report_months)
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

```

```{r cohort-segments-by-month}
#Sets the last day of the month, so that active segments can be counted per month.
#If they were added to the cohort AND enrolled in the same month, they will show
#as enrolled at the month end
month_ends <- tibble(
  month_end = seq(
    floor_date(params$start_date, "month"),
    floor_date(params$end_date, "month"),
    by = "1 month"
  ) %>% ceiling_date("month") - days(1)
)


# Use crossing() to pair each distinct source row with every month_end,
# creating one row per client per month_end date.
cohort_segments_tab_prep <- complex_care_full_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        enrollment_starting_date,
        roster_added_cohort_date,
        benchmarks_enrollment_date,
        benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date,
        benchmarks_treatment_team_assignment_date,
        enrollment_ending_date
      ),
      ymd
    )
  ) %>%
   tidyr::crossing(
     month_ends
     ) %>%
  filter(
    is.na(enrollment_ending_date) |
      enrollment_ending_date > month_end
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(roster_added_cohort_date),
    roster_added_cohort_date <= params$end_date
  ) %>%
  filter(
    roster_added_cohort_date <= month_end
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(month_end, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    cohort_segment = case_when(
      !is.na(benchmarks_treatment_team_assignment_date) &
        benchmarks_treatment_team_assignment_date <= month_end ~ "Assigned to Tx team, still in cohort",
      !is.na(benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date) &
        benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date <= month_end ~ "Admitted, not assigned to team",
      !is.na(benchmarks_enrollment_date) &
        benchmarks_enrollment_date <= month_end ~ "Enrolled, not admitted",
      !is.na(roster_added_cohort_date) &
        roster_added_cohort_date <= month_end ~ "Added to cohort, not enrolled",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    cohort_segment = factor(
    cohort_segment,
    levels = c(
      "Added to cohort, not enrolled",
      "Enrolled, not admitted",
      "Admitted, not assigned to team",
      "Assigned to Tx team, still in cohort"
    )
  )
  ) %>% 
  select(
    client_number,
    client_first,
    client_last,
    enrollment_starting_date,
    roster_added_cohort_date,
    benchmarks_enrollment_date,
    benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date,
    benchmarks_treatment_team_assignment_date,
    enrollment_ending_date,
    cohort_segment,
    month
  )

#Count cohort_segments by month, pivot_wider to create columns for each month
pipeline_snapshot_table <- cohort_segments_tab_prep %>%
  count(
    cohort_segment,
    month
    ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = month,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  adorn_totals("row")


status_month_table_fmt <- pipeline_snapshot_table %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      -cohort_segment,
      ~ if_else(
        cohort_segment == "Total",
        as.character(.x),
        paste0(
          .x,
         "&nbsp;&nbsp;",
          "<span style='color:#5A5A5A; font-size:90%;'>(",
          scales::percent(
            .x / .x[cohort_segment == "Total"],
            accuracy = 0.1
          ),
         ")</span>"
        )
      )
    )
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    `Cohort Segment` = cohort_segment
  )

```

```{r}
 filter(
```

<!-- Referral Source -->
```{r}
#| label: ref-source-prep

referral_source_table_prep <- complex_care_initiated %>% 
  select(
    client_number,
    enrollment_starting_date,
    roster_added_cohort_date,
    roster_complex_care_referral_source_description,
    ccnotes_decision,
    ccnotes_complex_care_clinical_committee_rationale_description,
    ccnotes_complex_care_reasons_ineligible_description,
    ccnotes_complex_care_other_outcomes_description
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    added_to_cohort = if_else(
      !is.na(roster_added_cohort_date),
      "Added to Cohort",
      "Not Added to Cohort"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    client_number,
    roster_complex_care_referral_source_description,
    added_to_cohort
    ) %>%
  count(
    roster_complex_care_referral_source_description,
    added_to_cohort,
    name = "n_clients"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = added_to_cohort,
    values_from = n_clients,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))
```

```{r}
#| label: alerting counts

#Filter to just clients active (on the alerting watchlist) during this reporting period
#Filter out any supplemental support clients
clients_active_fiscal_year <- complex_care_full_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(roster_added_cohort_date),
    roster_added_cohort_date <= "2026-09-30",
    (enrollment_ending_date >= params$start_date |
      is.na(enrollment_ending_date)
  )
 ) %>% 
  filter(
    roster_program_assigned != "Mercy BEACN - Supplemental Support"
  )

#Selects only key columns. Filters to the latest enrollment to ensure one row per client
clients_active_fiscal_select <- clients_active_fiscal_year %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(roster_added_cohort_date),
    roster_added_cohort_date <= params$start_date,
    (enrollment_ending_date >= params$start_date |
      is.na(enrollment_ending_date)
  )
 ) %>% 
  select(
    client_first,
    client_last,
    mrn_mercy,
    client_number,
    eto_case_num,
    enrollment_starting_date,
    roster_added_cohort_date,
    roster_program_assigned,
    benchmarks_enrollment_date,
    benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date,
    pfp_discharge_pfp_discharge_date,
    enrollment_ending_date
  ) %>% 
  group_by(
    mrn_mercy
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    enrollment_starting_date == max(
      enrollment_starting_date
    )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Create a list of possible member id values
member_id_lookup <- clients_active_fiscal_select %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      client_number,
      eto_case_num
    ),
    names_to = "matched_id_type",
    values_to = "member_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(member_id),
    member_id != ""
    ) %>%
  distinct(
    member_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>% 
  select(
    client_first,
    client_last,
    mrn_mercy,
    member_id,
    matched_id_type,
    roster_program_assigned
  )

#filter alerting data to the correct date range and filter out any irrelevant member_ids
alerting_data_filtered <- alerting_data %>% 
  mutate(
    member_id = as.character(atd_member_id),
    month_calendar_year_alert = zoo::as.yearmon(
      atd_discharge_date,
      "%B %Y"
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    atd_discharge_date >= params$start_date,
    atd_discharge_date <= params$end_date
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    member_id %in% member_id_lookup$member_id
    )

#Count of distinct clients with alerts during the period
distinct_clients_alerting_data <- alerting_data_filtered |>
  summarise(
    distinct_clients = n_distinct(client_number, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

#Filter's this periods alerting data to only show rows where the alert occurred prior to the client's enrollment
pre_enrollment_alerts <- alerting_data_filtered |> 
 filter(
  is.na(benchmarks_enrollment_date) |
  atd_discharge_date <= benchmarks_enrollment_date
 )


#JOin look up table with alerting table to add matched_id_type
alerting_data_w_type <- alerting_data_filtered %>% 
  left_join(
    member_id_lookup,
    by = "member_id"
  ) %>% 
  select(
    -client_first,
    -client_last,
    -mrn_mercy.y
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    mrn_mercy = mrn_mercy.x
  )

alerting_facility_location <- alerting_data_filtered %>% 
  filter(
    two_county == 1
  ) %>% 
  count(
    atd_visit_facility,
    name = "facility"
  )



alerting_data_all_cohort <- alerting_data_w_type %>% 
  select(
    client_number,
    atd_member_id,
    atd_admit_date,
    atd_iso_week,
    atd_iso_year,
    month_calendar_year_alert,
    enrollment_starting_date,
    roster_added_cohort_date,
    benchmarks_enrollment_date,
    enrollment_ending_date,
    enrollment_status
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(enrollment_status)
  )


#Monthly alerts by all clients
monthly_alerts_by_client_all  <- alerting_data_all_cohort |> 
 group_by(
  client_number,
  month_calendar_year_alert
 ) |> 
 summarise(
  n_alerts = n_distinct(
   atd_admit_date,
   na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  .groups = "drop"
 ) |> 
 pivot_wider(
  id_cols = client_number,
  names_from = month_calendar_year_alert,
  values_from = n_alerts,
  values_fill = 0
 )


alerts_by_month_status_wide <- alerting_data_all_cohort %>%
  count(

alerts_month_status_tab <- alerts_by_month_status_wide %>%

   ) %>%
```

<!-- alerting heatmap -->
```{r}
#| label: alerting-heatmap

# Create a vector of visit types of interest.
vis_type <- c(
  "Emergency",
  "Inpatient",
  "Behavioral Health",
  "General Medicine"
)

# Bold label vector for business days of the week
business_days  <- c(
  "Monday",
  "Tuesday",
  "Wednesday",
  "Thursday",
  "Friday"
  )

# Bold label vector for business hours
business_hours <- as.character(
  8:17
  )

# Reverse the YellowOrangeRed palette
rev_cols <- rev(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(
    9,
    "YlOrRd"
    )
  )

# Create a vector for shifting the hour sequence to start with 8 a.m.
rotated_hours <- c(
  8:23,
  0:7
)

# Prepare heatmap plot data.
heatmap_data <- alerting_data %>%
  filter(
    seven_county == 1
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    atd_alert_date >= "2026-07-01" &
      atd_alert_date <= "2026-09-30"
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    atd_visit_type %in% vis_type
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(
      atd_alert_hour
      ),
    !is.na(
      atd_alert_dow
      )
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    # # Factor using standard hourly scale 0:23
    # alert_hour = factor(
    #   alert_hour,
    #   levels = 0:23
    # ),
    # Factor using rotated hourly scale 8:23; 0:7
    atd_alert_hour = factor(
      atd_alert_hour,
      levels = rotated_hours
    ),
    # Reverse day of week order so Sunday appears at the top of the heatmap
    atd_alert_dow = factor(
      atd_alert_dow_chr,
      levels = c(
        "Saturday",
        "Friday",
        "Thursday",
        "Wednesday",
        "Tuesday",
        "Monday",
        "Sunday"
        )
      )
    ) %>% 
  count(
    atd_alert_dow,
    atd_alert_hour
    )

# Identify numeric positions for days of the week
dow_levels <- levels(
  heatmap_data$atd_alert_dow
  )

# Identify numeric positions for hours
hour_levels <- levels(
  heatmap_data$atd_alert_hour
  )

# Create 12-hour label vector using the standard hour order of 0:23
hour_labels_12 <- format(
  strptime(
    0:23,
    format = "%H"
    ),
  "%I %p"
  )

# Remove leading zeros
hour_labels_12 <- sub(
  "^0", "",
  hour_labels_12
  )

# Change to lower case for a.m./p.m.
hour_labels_12 <- tolower(
  hour_labels_12
  )

# Change am to a.m.
hour_labels_12 <- gsub(
  "am",
  "a",
  hour_labels_12
  )

# Change pm to p.m.
hour_labels_12 <- gsub(
  "pm",
  "p",
  hour_labels_12
  )

# Define 12-hour labels for the rotated hour scale starting with 8 a.m. Use +1
# because R is 1-indexed.
hour_labels_12_rotated <- hour_labels_12[rotated_hours + 1]

# Compute the corners for the business week rectangle
x_min <- which(
  hour_levels == "8"
  )  - 0.5
x_max <- which(
  hour_levels == "17"
  ) + 0.5
y_min <- which(
  dow_levels  == "Friday"
  ) - 0.5
y_max <- which(
  dow_levels  == "Monday"
  ) + 0.5

# Create a five-point path that traces the perimeter of the business week block
# and save to data frame
rect_outline <- data.frame(
  x = c(
    x_min,
    x_max,
    x_max,
    x_min,
    x_min
    ),
  y = c(
    y_min,
    y_min,
    y_max,
    y_max,
    y_min
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HEATMAP: Alerts by Day of Week and Hour of Day
#
# Purpose:
#   Visualize temporal patterns in ATD alerts to identify operational gaps
#   between alert timing and outreach team availability.
#
# Key design decisions:
#   - Hours on x-axis (left-to-right scanning emphasizes hourly patterns)
#   - Days on y-axis (Sunday at top for intuitive calendar orientation)
#   - Darker colors = more alerts (reversed YlOrRd palette)
#   - Dashed rectangle highlights business hours (Mon–Fri, 8–17)
#   - Square tiles for perceptual balance (coord_fixed)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
heatmap <- ggplot() +
  # Draw the individual tiles
  geom_tile(
    data = heatmap_data,
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(
        atd_alert_hour
        ),
      y = as.numeric(
        atd_alert_dow
        ),
      fill = n
      ),
    color = "white"
    ) +
  # Draw a dashed border around the business week. Use of geom_path() avoids
  # clipping issues in geom_rect()
  geom_path(
    data = rect_outline,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y
      ),
    color = "black",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # scale_x_continuous for the standard 0:23 hourly scale
  # scale_x_continuous(
  #   breaks = seq_along(
  #     hour_levels
  #   ),
  #   labels = hour_labels_12,
  #   expand = c(
  #     0, 
  #     0
  #   )
  # ) + 
  # scale_x_continuous for rotated hourly scale 8:23; 0:7
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(
      rotated_hours
      ),
    labels = hour_labels_12_rotated,
    expand = c(
      0,
      0
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(
      dow_levels
    ),
    labels = dow_levels,
    expand = c(
      0,
      0
    )
  ) +
  # Fill palette
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = rev_cols,
    trans = "reverse"
  ) +
  labs(
    # title = "ATD Alerts by Day of Week and Hour",
    x = "Hour of Day",
    y = "Day of Week",
    fill = "Alert Count"
    # caption = "Includes ATD alerts from visit facilities in the seven-county eastern Missouri region (St. Louis area), limited to Behavioral Health, Emergency, General Medicine, and Inpatient visits, for alerts sent on or after July 1, 2025."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 14
    ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      face = ifelse(
        levels(
          heatmap_data$atd_alert_hour
          ) %in% business_hours,
        "bold",
        "plain"
        ),
      size = 8
      ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = ifelse(
        levels(
          heatmap_data$atd_alert_dow
          ) %in% business_days,
        "bold",
        "plain"
        )
      ),
    legend.position = "bottom"
    ) + 
  # Force square tiles for perceptual clarity
  coord_fixed()

heatmap

```

```{r}
#| label: utilization-data-prep

#Any admissions that occurred during this quarter
quarterly_mercy_utilization <- mercy_utilization %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(adm_date_time),
    adm_date_time >= params$start_date,
    adm_date_time <= params$end_date
  )

#Filter FAMCare data to include only clients in the cohort for some length of time this quarter
#left join mercy data.
#Create In Outreach vs. Enrolled column
cohort_v_enrolled_utiliz_tab_prep <-complex_care_full_data %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(roster_added_cohort_date),
    roster_added_cohort_date <= params$end_date,
    is.na(enrollment_ending_date) | enrollment_ending_date >=params$start_date
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    quarterly_mercy_utilization,
    by = c("mrn_mercy" = "pat_mrn_id")
  )%>% 
  mutate(
 group = case_when(
    (is.na(benchmarks_enrollment_date) |
      benchmarks_enrollment_date > params$end_date) ~ "In Outreach",
      (!is.na(benchmarks_enrollment_date) & benchmarks_enrollment_date <= params$end_date) ~ "Enrolled"
  )
 )%>% 
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "In Outreach",
        "Enrolled")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    group
  )%>% 
  summarise(
    n_clients_tot = n_distinct(client_number),
    n_clients_w_util = n_distinct(
      client_number[!is.na(patient_class)]),
    er_count  = sum(patient_class == "Emergency", na.rm = TRUE),
    ip_count  = sum(patient_class == "Inpatient", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = er_count + ip_count
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    percent_util = scales::percent(
      n_clients_w_util/n_clients_tot, 
      accuracy = 1)
  ) %>% 
  relocate(
    percent_util,
    .after = n_clients_w_util
  )
```

<!-- Utilization Pre and Post Enrollment Plot -->

```{r}
#| label: annual-utilization-vis-setup
# Calculate months elapsed post-enrollment per patient based on the date_created field from the Mercy extract:
patient_windows <- quarterly_enrolled_utilization %>%
	select(
		mrn_mercy,
		benchmarks_enrollment_date,
		date_created
	) %>%
  distinct(
    mrn_mercy,
		benchmarks_enrollment_date,
		.keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>% 
  group_by(
    mrn_mercy,
		benchmarks_enrollment_date,
		date_created
  ) %>% 
	reframe(
		months_post = interval(
			benchmarks_enrollment_date,
			date_created
		) %/% months(
			1
		),
		months_pre = interval(
		  date_created,
		  benchmarks_enrollment_date
		) %/% months(
			1
		)
	)

#Count total clients who appear in the utilization data
n_clients <- quarterly_enrolled_utilization %>%
  filter(
  !is.na(benchmarks_enrollment_date)
  )%>% 
  distinct(client_number) %>%
  nrow()

#Create ed_visit and ip_visit

# Left join patient_windows to complex_care_full_data
utilization_w_month_diff <- quarterly_enrolled_utilization %>%
	left_join(
		patient_windows,
		by = c(
			"mrn_mercy",
			"benchmarks_enrollment_date",
			"date_created"
		)
	) %>%
	mutate(
		month_diff = interval(
			benchmarks_enrollment_date,
			adm_date_time
		) %/% months(
			1
		)
	) %>% 
	filter(
		month_diff >= -months_post &
			month_diff <= months_post
	) %>%
  group_by(
		month_diff
	) %>%
  mutate(
    ed_visit = case_when(
      patient_class == "Emergency" ~ 1,
      .default = 0
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    inpatient_visit = case_when(
      patient_class == "Inpatient" ~ 1,
      .default = 0
    )
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    ed_count = sum(
			ed_visit,
			 na.rm = TRUE
		),
    ip_count = sum(
			inpatient_visit,
			 na.rm = TRUE
		),
    distinct_patients = n_distinct(
			mrn_mercy
		)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Reshape for line plotting
line_data <- utilization_w_month_diff %>%
  select(
		month_diff,
		 ed_count,
		  ip_count
		) %>%
  pivot_longer(
		cols = c(
			ed_count,
			 ip_count
			),
			names_to = "utilization_type",
      values_to = "count"
		)
```

<!-- 30-Day Return Rates -->
```{r}
#| label: thirty-day-return-setup
# Note - filter out high-utilizers first
thirty_day_return_setup <- quarterly_enrolled_utilization %>% 
  select(
    client_number,
    client_last,
    client_first,
    mrn_mercy,
    benchmarks_enrollment_date,
    date_created,
    adm_date_time,
    patient_class,
    ed_visit,
    inpatient_visit,
    ed_30day_return_flag,
    ip_30day_return_flag
  ) 

thirty_day_return_check <- thirty_day_return_setup |> 
  filter(
    ed_30day_return_flag == 1
  )

patient_windows_thirty_day <- thirty_day_return_setup %>%
	select(
		mrn_mercy,
		benchmarks_enrollment_date,
		date_created
	) %>%
  distinct(
    mrn_mercy,
		benchmarks_enrollment_date,
		date_created,
		.keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>% 
  group_by(
    mrn_mercy,
		benchmarks_enrollment_date,
		date_created
  ) %>% 
	reframe(
		months_post = interval(
			benchmarks_enrollment_date,
			date_created
		) %/% months(
			1
		),
		months_pre = interval(
		  date_created,
		  benchmarks_enrollment_date
		) %/% months(
			1
		)
	)

n_clients_30_day_ed <- thirty_day_return_setup %>%
  filter(
  !is.na(benchmarks_enrollment_date),
  patient_class == "Emergency"
  ) %>% 
  distinct(client_number) %>%
  nrow()

n_clients_30_day_ip <- thirty_day_return_setup %>%
  filter(
  !is.na(benchmarks_enrollment_date),
  patient_class == "Inpatient"
  ) %>% 
  distinct(client_number) %>%
  nrow()

thirty_day_return_with_month_diff <- thirty_day_return_setup %>% 
  left_join(
    patient_windows_thirty_day,
    by = c(
      "mrn_mercy",
      "benchmarks_enrollment_date",
      "date_created"
    )
  )%>%
	mutate(
		month_diff = interval(
			benchmarks_enrollment_date,
			adm_date_time
		) %/% months(
			1
		),
		period = case_when(
      adm_date_time < benchmarks_enrollment_date  ~ "Pre",
      adm_date_time >= benchmarks_enrollment_date ~ "Post",
      .default = NA_character_
    )
	) %>% 
	filter(
		month_diff >= -months_post &
			month_diff <= months_post
	) %>%
  group_by(
		month_diff
	)

#########
#This section was added after production of the final brief to verify rates
#and assure PMs of accuracy.

client_rates <- thirty_day_return_with_month_diff |> 
  group_by(
    client_number,
    period
    )%>%
  summarise(
    ed_visits = sum(ed_visit == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    ed_returns = sum(ed_visit == 1 & ed_30day_return_flag == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    ip_visits = sum(inpatient_visit == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    ip_returns = sum(inpatient_visit == 1 & ip_30day_return_flag == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ed_return_rate = ed_returns / na_if(ed_visits, 0),
    ip_return_rate = ip_returns / na_if(ip_visits, 0)
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = client_number,
    names_from = period,
    values_from = c(
      ed_visits,
      ed_returns,
      ip_visits,
      ip_returns,
      ed_return_rate,
      ip_return_rate
    ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{period}",
    names_vary = "slowest"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
  across(
    contains("_rate"),
    ~ scales::percent(.x, accuracy = 0.1)
  )
)

client_return_rates <- client_rates %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    ed_return_rate_overall = sum(ed_returns) / na_if(sum(ed_visits), 0),
    ip_return_rate_overall = sum(ip_returns) / na_if(sum(ip_visits), 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


client_rates_by_period <- client_rates %>%
  select(client_number, period, ed_return_rate, ip_return_rate) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = period,
    values_from = c(ed_return_rate, ip_return_rate),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{period}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      -client_number,
      ~ scales::percent(.x, accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: tot-adj-charges

total_charges_step_one <- quarterly_enrolled_utilization %>% 
  select(
    client_number,
    client_last,
    client_first,
    mrn_mercy,
    benchmarks_enrollment_date,
    adm_date_time,
    patient_class,
    tot_chgs,
    tot_adj
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      adm_date_time <  benchmarks_enrollment_date ~ "Pre-enrollment",
      adm_date_time >= benchmarks_enrollment_date ~ "Post-enrollment"
    )
  )

#Calculate total adjusted charges by client for both periods, pre and post enrollment
adj_by_client_period <- total_charges_step_one %>%
  group_by(
    client_number,
    client_last,
    period
    ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_adj = sum(
      tot_adj,
      na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = period,
    values_from = total_adj,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    adj_change = `Post-enrollment` - `Pre-enrollment`,
    direction = if_else(adj_change >= 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    client_number = reorder(client_number, -adj_change),
    label = scales::dollar(adj_change)
  )

#Count number of bars/clients to use in label
n__tot_adj_charges <- nrow(adj_by_client_period)


charge_change_summary <- adj_by_client_period %>%
  summarise(
    clients_positive_change = sum(adj_change > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    clients_negative_change = sum(adj_change < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    clients_no_change = sum(adj_change == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: housing
current_housing_status_v2 <- complex_care_full_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(benchmarks_enrollment_date),
    benchmarks_enrollment_date <= params$end_date,
    (is.na(enrollment_ending_date) |
    (enrollment_ending_date >= params$start_date
     &
     enrollment_ending_date <= params$end_date
     )
    )
  )%>% 
    select(
    client_number,,
    client_last,
    enrollment_starting_date,
    roster_added_cohort_date,
    benchmarks_enrollment_date,
    housing_initial_housing_status_description,
    housing_latest_housing_status_description
    )

housing_status_change <- current_housing_status_v2 |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(housing_initial_housing_status_description)
  ) |> 
mutate(
    housing_outcome = case_when(
      !housing_initial_housing_status_description %in% c("Stably Housed", "Precariously Housed", "Institutionally Housed")
      & housing_latest_housing_status_description %in% c("Stably Housed", "Precariously Housed", "Institutionally Housed")
      ~ "Achieved housing",

      housing_initial_housing_status_description %in% c("Stably Housed", "Precariously Housed", "Institutionally Housed")
      & housing_latest_housing_status_description %in% c("Stably Housed", "Precariously Housed", "Institutionally Housed")
      ~ "Maintained housing",

      !is.na(housing_initial_housing_status_description) & !is.na(housing_latest_housing_status_description) ~
        "Did not achieve/maintain housing",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

housing_change_summary <- housing_status_change |> 
  summarise(
    n_clients = sum(!is.na(housing_outcome)),
    
    n_achieved_or_maintained = sum(
      housing_outcome %in% c(
        "Achieved housing",
        "Maintained housing"
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    pct_achieved_or_maintained =
      n_achieved_or_maintained / n_clients
  )

#Pivot Longer to create one row per time point, so two rows per client. Collapse
#Housing categories into housed and unhoused
current_housing_status_plot_prep <- current_housing_status_v2 %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(housing_initial_housing_status_description,
             housing_latest_housing_status_description
             ),
    names_to = "timepoint",
    values_to = "housing_status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = recode(
      timepoint,
      housing_initial_housing_status_description = "Baseline",
      housing_latest_housing_status_description  = "Current"
    ),
    housing_binary = case_when(
      housing_status %in% c("Institutionally Housed", "Precariously Housed", "Stably Housed") ~ "Housed",
      housing_status == "Unhoused" ~ "Unhoused",
      housing_status == "Unknown" ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    housing_binary = factor(
      housing_binary,
      levels = c("Unhoused", "Housed", "Unknown")
    )
  ) 

#Count only Non-Missing Values to Plot
housing_counts <- current_housing_status_plot_prep %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(housing_binary)
    ) %>%
  count(
    timepoint,
    housing_binary,
    name = "n"
    ) %>% 
  complete(
    timepoint,
    housing_binary,
    fill = list(n=0)
  )

#Plot using collapsed categories
binary_housing_plot <- ggplot(
  housing_counts,
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = n,
      fill = housing_binary
      )
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width = 0.7
    ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = if_else(n > 0, as.character(n), "")),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 6
  ) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    # subtitle = paste0(
    #   "Missing/unknown excluded"
    # ),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
    # caption = "Note: Unknown values excluded"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
  "Housed"   = "#0072B2", 
  "Unhoused" = "#D55E00",
  "Unknown" = "gray"
    )
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
)+
theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
theme(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
  plot.title = element_text(
    size = 18,
    hjust = 0.5
  ),
  plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 20, b = 10, l = 20)
)
```

```{r}
    enrollment_starting_date,
    roster_added_cohort_date,
    benchmarks_enrollment_date,
    payor_initial_payor_source_description,
    payor_latest_payor_source_description
    ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(payor_initial_payor_source_description,
             payor_latest_payor_source_description
             ),
    names_to = "timepoint",
    values_to = "payor_source"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = recode(
      timepoint,
      payor_initial_payor_source_description = "Baseline",
      payor_latest_payor_source_description  = "Current"
    ),
    insurance_binary = case_when(
      payor_source %in% c("Medicaid", "Medicare", "Managed Medicaid", "Medicaid Application In Progress", "Dual Eligible (Medicare & Medicaid)", "Private Insurance") ~ "Insured",
      payor_source == "Uninsured" ~ "Uninsured",
      payor_source == "Unknown/Refused" ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_   # includes Missing/Unknown/anything else
    ),
     insurance_binary = factor(
      insurance_binary,
      levels = c("Uninsured", "Insured", "Unknown")
    )
  ) 

#Now Count only Non-Missing Values to Plot
insurance_counts <- current_payor_plot_prep %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(insurance_binary)
    ) %>%
  count(
    timepoint,
    insurance_binary,
    name = "n"
    )%>% 
  complete(
    timepoint,
    insurance_binary,
    fill = list(n = 0)
    )

binary_insurance_plot <- ggplot(
  insurance_counts,
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = n,
      fill = insurance_binary
      )
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width = 0.7
    ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(n == 0, "", n)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 6
  ) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
  "Insured"   = "#0072B2", 
  "Uninsured" = "#D55E00",
  "Unknown" = "gray"
    )
  )+
   scale_y_continuous(
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
)+
theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
theme(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
  plot.title = element_text(
    size = 18,
    hjust = 0.5
  ),
  plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 20, b = 10, l = 20)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: shelter-beds-single-column

complex_care_shelter_beds <- complex_care_data$complex_care_data$raw$complex_care_shelter_beds

shelter_beds_step_one <- complex_care_shelter_beds %>% 
  select(
    visit_date,
    client_number,
    date_offered_shelter_bed,
    decision_shelter_bed,
    start_date_shelter_bed,
    end_date_shelter_bed
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    start_date_shelter_bed = ymd(start_date_shelter_bed),
    end_date_shelter_bed   = ymd(end_date_shelter_bed),
    end_date_fixed = coalesce((end_date_shelter_bed - 1), params$end_date) 
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(start_date_shelter_bed),
    start_date_shelter_bed <= params$end_date,
    start_date_shelter_bed >= params$start_date |
    is.na(end_date_shelter_bed) |
    end_date_shelter_bed >= params$start_date
  )

#Count distinct clients
tot_clients <- shelter_beds_step_one %>% 
 summarise(
  n_clients = n_distinct(client_number)
 )

#Attempt to create BedID

assign_beds <- function(shelter_beds_step_one) {

  shelter_beds_step_one <- shelter_beds_step_one %>%
    arrange(
      start_date_shelter_bed,
      end_date_fixed
      )

  bed_status <- reduce(
    .x = seq_len(nrow(shelter_beds_step_one)),
    .init = list(
      bed_free = c(as.Date("1900-01-01"), as.Date("1900-01-01"), as.Date("1900-01-01")),
      bed_id   = integer(nrow(shelter_beds_step_one))
    ),
    .f = function(bed_status, i) {

      s <- shelter_beds_step_one$start_date_shelter_bed[i]
      e <- shelter_beds_step_one$end_date_fixed[i]
      free <- which(bed_status$bed_free <= s)
      b <- if (length(free) >= 1) free[1] else NA_integer_
      bed_status$bed_id[i] <- b
      if (!is.na(b)) bed_status$bed_free[b] <- e

      bed_status
    }
  )

 shelter_beds_step_one %>%
    mutate(
      bed_id = if_else(is.na(bed_status$bed_id),
                       NA_character_,
                       paste0("Bed ", bed_status$bed_id)
                       ),
      error = is.na(bed_status$bed_id)
    )
}

shelter_beds_w_id <- assign_beds(shelter_beds_step_one)

  
shelter_beds_id_long <- shelter_beds_w_id %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    last_night = end_date_fixed,
    date = list(

        from = start_date_shelter_bed,
        to   = last_night,
      by   = "day"
    )
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(date) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

    date >= params$start_date,
    date <= params$end_date

  select(
    date,
    bed_id
  )
```

```{r}
 filter(

#Create weeks_since_selection and possible_outreach_weeks.

 filter(

 relocate(

 ) |> 
 select(
```

```{r}
#| label: weekly-outreach-summary
#Keeps one row per outreach note (weekly) by client. Parses out counts of virtual
#and in-person attempts. Calculates iso week and year.
outreach_notes_v3 <- complex_care_outreach_notes |> 
 select(
  -id,
  -docserno,
  -parent_docserno,
  -visit_time,
  -cc_outreach_collateral_contact_code
 ) |>
 mutate(
  across(
   c(
    num_outreach_attempts_in_person,
    num_outreach_attempts_phone_virtual,
    num_outreach_attempts_at_hospital,
    num_outreach_contact_w_client
   ),
   as.numeric
  )
 ) |> 
 filter(
  cc_outreach_attempt == "Yes"
 ) |> 
 mutate(
  tot_outreach_attempts = 
   num_outreach_attempts_in_person +
    num_outreach_attempts_phone_virtual
 ) |> 
 select(
    client_number,
    added_cohort_date,
    alert_week,
    tot_outreach_attempts
  ) |> 
 rename(
  outreach_week = alert_week
 ) |> 
  mutate(
    week_date = lubridate::mdy(
      stringr::str_remove(outreach_week, "^Week of ")
    ),
    iso_week = lubridate::isoweek(week_date),
    iso_year = lubridate::isoyear(week_date)
  )


weekly_outreach_by_client <- outreach_notes_v3 |> 
 group_by(
  client_number,
  iso_week,
  iso_year
 )


#Label and order each alert and outreach week
week_columns <- as.vector(rbind(
  paste0("alert_week_", 1:53),
  paste0("outreach_week_", 1:53)
))

#Create table of all report weeks within the reporting period
report_weeks <- tibble(
  week_start = seq.Date(
    from = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(
      params$start, "week", week_start = 1
    )),
    to = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(
      params$end, "week", week_start = 1
    )),
    by = "week"
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    week_end = week_start + 6,
    iso_year = lubridate::isoyear(week_start),
    iso_week = lubridate::isoweek(week_start)
  )

#Create one row per client for every reporting week. Create an Active status 
#column to flag if the client was in the cohort, but not enrolled during that week.
cohort_table_join <- complex_care_full_data |> 
 filter(
  !is.na(roster_docserno),
  !is.na(roster_added_cohort_date),
  roster_added_cohort_date <= params$end_date,
  (is.na(benchmarks_enrollment_date)|
    benchmarks_enrollment_date >= params$start_date
  ),
  (is.na(enrollment_ending_date)|
    enrollment_ending_date >= params$start_date
  )
 ) |> 
  select(
  client_number,
    client_last,
    client_first,
    enrollment_starting_date,
    roster_added_cohort_date,
    benchmarks_enrollment_date,
    benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date,
    enrollment_ending_date
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  crossing(
   report_weeks
   ) |>
  mutate(
    active = !is.na(roster_added_cohort_date) &
      roster_added_cohort_date <= week_end &
      (is.na(benchmarks_enrollment_date) |
         benchmarks_enrollment_date >= week_start)
  )




#Join in weekly outreach data
cohort_outreach_join <- cohort_table_join |> 
left_join(
  weekly_outreach_by_client,
  by = c("client_number",
         "iso_week"
     ))

#Join in weekly alerting data
cohort_outreach_alerting_join <- cohort_outreach_join |> 
 left_join(
  weekly_alerts_by_client_outreach,
  by = c("client_number",
         "iso_week"
 )) 


#Filter to weeks where teh client was active in the cohort.
#Create binary indicators for any_outreach and any_alerts
cohort_outreach_alerting_filtered <- cohort_outreach_alerting_join |> 
 select(
  # -benchmarks_enrollment_date,
  -benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date,
  -benchmarks_complete_admission_service_date,
  -enrollment_ending_date,
  -outreach_week,
  -week_start,
  -week_end,
  -added_cohort_date,
  -iso_year.y
 ) |> 
 filter(
  active == "TRUE"
 ) |> 
 mutate(
  any_outreach = case_when(
   !is.na(tot_outreach_attempts) ~ 1,
   .default = 0
  ),
  any_alert = case_when(
   !is.na(n_alerts) ~ 1,
   .default = 0
  )
 )

distinct_clients <- cohort_outreach_alerting_filtered|>
  summarise(
    distinct_clients = n_distinct(client_number, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# alerting_data_filtered |>
#   anti_join(
#     cohort_outreach_alerting_filtered,
#     by = "client_number"
#   ) |>
#   distinct(client_number, .keep_all = TRUE)


non_na_alerts <- cohort_outreach_alerting_filtered |> 
 filter(
  !is.na(n_alerts)
  )


#Group by week, year. Gives an overview of how many clients were outreached and how
#many clients received any number of alerts that week.
summary_by_week <- cohort_outreach_alerting_filtered |>
  group_by(
   iso_week,
   iso_year.x
   ) |>
  summarise(
    active_clients = n_distinct(
     client_number
     ),
   clients_with_outreach = sum(
    any_outreach
    ),
    pct_clients_with_outreach =
      100 * mean(any_outreach),
    clients_with_alerts = sum(
     any_alert
     ),
    clients_with_alerts_and_outreach =
      sum(
       any_alert == 1 & any_outreach == 1
       ),
    pct_alert_clients_with_outreach = case_when(
      sum(any_alert) > 0 ~
      100 * sum(any_alert == 1 & any_outreach == 1) /
           sum(any_alert),
       .default = NA_real_
       ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
   iso_week,
   iso_year.x
   )

#summary by week formatted to a table
#Pull the actual date out of ISO format
summary_by_week_clean <- summary_by_week |> 
    mutate(
    week_start = lubridate::floor_date(
      lubridate::make_date(iso_year.x, 1, 4),
      unit = "week",
      week_start = 1
    ) + 7 * (iso_week - 1),
    `Week Starting` = format(week_start, "%m/%d/%Y")
  ) %>%
  select(-iso_year.x, -iso_week, -week_start) %>%
  relocate(`Week Starting`) |> 
  mutate(
    across(
      c(pct_clients_with_outreach, pct_alert_clients_with_outreach),
      ~ scales::percent(.x, accuracy = 0.1, scale = 1)
    )
  ) 

summary_by_week_tab <- summary_by_week_clean %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Week Starting",
      "Active Clients",
      "Clients with Outreach",
      "% with Outreach",
      "Clients with Alerts",
      "Clients with Alerts and Outreach",
      "% of Clients with Alerts Receiving Outreach"
    ),
    align = c("l", rep("c", 6))
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) |> 
    row_spec(
    0,
    bold = TRUE,
    background = "#BCDFF1"
  ) %>%
  column_spec(
    4,
    bold = TRUE
  ) |> 
   column_spec(
    7,
    bold = TRUE
  )
```
